content.value: Define dependence of vectors. Determine whether the vectors are linearly independent or (11) linearly dependent:

$$
\underline { { \mathcal { A } } } = 2 \underline { { i } } + \underline { { j } } - 3 \underline { { k } } , \underline { { B } } = \underline { { i } } - 4 \underline { { k } } , \underline { { C } } = 4 \underline { { i } } + 3 \underline { { j } } - \underline { { k } } .
$$
